notes.title: Dinos Vs. Robots Vs. Timelines!
notes.notes:
Steam’s Dinos Vs. Robots Fest has officially launched. Checkout Timepunk for some intensive roguelike bullet hell fun against raptors, stegosaurus, robots, pterodactyls, and more. Timepunk is available to Wishlist now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006957/dd946c51c4ebfc4eb6724f4038f9b1e2133918c6.png[/img]

Timepunk is a fast-paced 2D roguelike top-down bullet hell game that takes you on an adrenaline-fueled journey through time! Embark on an epic adventure, starting in the Jurassic and prehistoric era – fighting hordes of dinosaurs like the stegosaurus, raptors, pterodactyls and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006957/ea879b0bb782a98dddd6fd2cc0c35fd659f16778.gif[/img]
As you travel across different timelines, additional weapons will unlock providing you more advantages against the onslaught of foes. Beware, as your arsenal of weapons grows with power in each timeline, so too grows the strength and caliber of enemies across each period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006957/8af23d15215532a64abc3aa331f29ce718ec2305.png[/img]

Timepunk includes a PvE co-op multiplayer and single-player experience. Do you have what it takes to travel across each timeline, take on hordes of enemies, and defeat the Society of Time?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006957/e90c4eb627cc1b00499af9103ee1aba4a819587a.png[/img]

notes.title: Let's Play Remotely Together!
notes.notes:
Steam’ Remote Play Together Fest kicks off today and Timepunk is one of the several titles taking part in this fantastic event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006957/ec33d5263441a95c292b0bc4940bc84d1a29662c.png[/img]

Join us today until Feb 19th to take a deeper look into Timepunk! Timepunk is a 2D roguelike bullet hell game where a hero from the future has been thrown to the dinosaur era. In a journey to reach your original timeline and get revenge against the Society of time, you can expect:
[list]
[*] Fast paced gameplay for you and up to 3 other friends
[*] Roguelike bullet hell with tons of different enemies across time to fight and survive against
[*] Create time portals that allow you to unlock and upgrade your hero
[*] Mess up the timelines through your own actions. If you want to fight a NAZI-Zombie riding a Mecha-Dinosaur, you just need to make the right decisions to get there.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006957/e90c4eb627cc1b00499af9103ee1aba4a819587a.png[/img]
